name: forms
title: Accessible forms + contact pipeline
summary: Floating-label fields, honeypot, submit hook and a working contact form wired to a rate-limited, stored, emailed API route.
when: The site has a contact, enquiry, RSVP, waitlist or sign-up form that must actually reach someone.
next: Render <ContactForm /> where the brief needs it, or compose your own form from src/forms/fields.tsx + useSubmit.
Restyle freely: every class is a design token, nothing is hard-coded.
